work_package.name: Manager relay ingress AEAD and cross-path non-live core
work_package.goal: promote the N3-W host-only relay contract into an importable Manager core while leaving production MQTT wiring, real key stores, firmware, and physical execution disabled
allowed: strict gateway relay topic and gh.relay/1 envelope parser
single-hop, gateway/node, active-node, key-epoch authorization ports
deterministic uint64 boot-session plus uint32 seq nonce derivation
deterministic AAD binding for schema, transport, gateway_id, node_id, hop_count, key_epoch, boot_id, seq
AES-256-GCM adapter backed by the existing cryptography development dependency
packaged gh.telemetry/1 schema validation without tightening the global legacy boot_id schema
persistent replay-registry inspection before AEAD and atomic commit after complete telemetry validation
non-live direct/relay cross-path duplicate model using the same ReplayRegistry
focused unit, restart, fault, and cross-path tests
dedicated GitHub CI and Draft PR
forbidden: real gateway credential or key store integration
ESP-NOW firmware or ESPHome product changes
T1, node, board, Broker, Home Assistant, production Manager database, or credential access

exit_gate: valid relay frame decrypts and returns the existing direct-ingress handoff topic without publishing
inactive node, unauthorized gateway-node pair, and unknown key epoch fail closed
zero/malformed boot session, seq overflow, nonce mismatch, malformed base64, frame size, and non-single-hop conditions fail closed
AAD/ciphertext tamper fails AEAD without consuming replay state
inner node_id/boot_id/seq mismatch and complete telemetry validation failures do not consume replay state
replay registry unavailable or stale boot session fails closed before canonical handoff
direct then relay and relay then direct duplicates share the persistent registry
global gh.telemetry/1 remains compatible with legacy boot_id formats outside the N3-W envelope
next_gate: Production MQTT relay subscription, real authorization/key stores, direct-ingress production replay wiring, Ready/merge, firmware, dual-board isolation tests, and all live or physical execution remain separate authorizations.
